description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of entity types in a biomedical named entity recognition dataset, with the largest segment representing "Chemical" at 32%, followed by "Protein" at 15%, "DNA" at 6%, and "Chemical Family" and "Disease" each at 5%. Other categories include "Cell Type" (5%), "Drug" (4%), "Frequency" (3%), "Cell Line" (3%), "Dosage" (3%), "Strength" (2%), "Gene Or Gene Product" (2%), "Form" (2%), "Disease Or Phenotypic Feature" (2%), "Route" (1%), "Reason" (1%), "Sequence Variant" (1%), "Modifier" (1%), "RNA" (1%), "Disease Class" (1%), "Organism Taxon" (1%), "Duration" (1%), "ADE" (1%), and "Composite Mention" (1%). The chart uses distinct colors for each category, with labels and percentages clearly displayed within or adjacent to the corresponding slices.
